_about: The poses of AnkiQuest's companions, read by the server, the clients and tools/art-check; a pose's master is <companion>/<pose>.png, listed in manifest.json. core lists the poses every live companion needs: a new companion goes live only with all of them drawn. extensions maps each further pose to its fallback, a core pose or another extension that eventually reaches one; a companion with no master for an extension shows its fallback. core_fallbacks maps a core pose to the core pose shown instead, used only while a companion has no master for that core pose (manifest.json lists those under missing). Fallbacks are a stopgap until every live companion has every pose drawn (AnkiQuest/AnkiQuest-Server#57): a core_fallbacks entry goes once every live companion has that pose drawn, and the extension fallbacks go once every extension is drawn too.
